description.narrative: The Fund will provide growth capital to 7-10 mid-market companies in South Africa, across sectors such as FMCG, industrial services, logistics, retail, hospitality and tourism. Capitalworks will continue its value creation strategy that has been successfully implemented in the three prior funds, such as supporting its portfolio companies in business & product development, operational improvement, ESG enhancement and digitization. Additionally, the Fund is also expected to support jobs through its portfolio companies, with its 21 portfolio companies to date supporting around 30,000 jobs, and having created around 4,500 new jobs since the Fund Manager's entry.

The proposed project is for IFC to commit up to US$40 million in Capitalworks Private Equity Fund IV (Capitalworks IV or the Fund), with a co-investment envelope of US$40 million. Capitalworks IV is a South-African focused generalist Private Equity (PE) fund, targeting significant influence in growing mid-market companies, across multiple sectors such as fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), industrial services, logistics, retail, hospitality & tourism. The Fund is targeting to raise total commitments of US$350 million.
